single_strategy_change.name: exclusive FAR auction-origin ownership
single_strategy_change.rule: ordinary FAR may delegate to the preserved implementation only when rejection_seed=true and acceptance_seed=false
single_strategy_change.reason: a mixed/acceptance-origin auction needs an explicit acceptance-failure state and must not be relabelled by generic reclaim+MSS

decision_rule: Use L1 only to determine whether the identified state aliasing mechanism is causally removed. Regardless of performance, do not claim success. A surviving candidate must be frozen before a newly reserved continuous interval is collected.
